user.title: Idegis / AstralPool cloud-MITM receiver
user.description: This Home Assistant instance will run its own receiver for the chlorinator's cloud protocol. Prerequisite (done once, outside HA): your LAN's DNS override / reverse proxy for api.idegis.net must forward to this instance's HTTP port, at /api/idegis_astralpool/interface/read.php and write.php. See docs/06-installation-and-lan.md in the repository.
